column1: # NorthNarrow — V2 validation campaign — frozen rule denominator.
# frozen: 2026-10-15, before any V2 run (external audit NN-AUD-217, NN-AUD-235).
# version 2 (2026-10-16, lab PR 163, before any V2 run): NN-L-NET-003 leaves
# the Critical sub-gate (gate -), inactive until BUG-025 (no sensor produces
# a TLS fingerprint); it stays in the denominator. NN-L-CANARY-003 stays in
# the sub-gate: a connect to a network canary now trips it.
# version 3 (2026-10-20, lab PR 219, before any V2 run): the exploit
# post-condition guard's two rules, NN-L-EPG-001 (credentials, T1068) and
# NN-L-EPG-002 (namespaces and root, T1611), issued outside the engine
# (`direct`), Critical, in the sub-gate: family exploit-guard.
# One row per rule the agent can record: the 76 rules the production engine
# NN-L-EPG-001/002, which process_event issues outside the engine. The rule-coverage headline and the
# Critical sub-gate are computed over these rows and no others; matrix.md
# gives the formulas and the sha256 of this file. A change is a new version,
# recorded there before the family it touches runs.
# agent/src/decision/validation_registry.rs checks this file against the code.
#   rule_id  the id the agent records (Verdict.rule_id)
#   family   the matrix roll-up family; one evasion and one benign control
#   where    engine = loaded by the production engine; direct = issued
#   gate     critical = in the 100 % Critical sub-gate: every rule design
#            §13 Q1 names, and every other rule that can issue a Critical
#            verdict on the agent as built (NN-L-NET-003 cannot until
#   q1       yes = named by Q1 itself (FIM-001/002/008/010/021/022 and every
#   status   in = in the denominator; n/a:<reason> = left out, decided in a
